title: "AI agent instructions"

The developers sometimes use AI coding agents such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to assist in their work.
To make this more effective, we supply instructions for this repository in [`AGENTS.md`](https://agents.md/) at the root of the repository.
Keep the instructions short and specific to this repository; generic advice makes agents slower and more expensive without making them better.
